questions.text: I lean towards ___ for getting the latest news/information

options.text: Youtube / Ted Talks
Podcasts / Audiobooks
Books / eBooks / Newspapers
Social Gatherings

questions.text: When I was studying, I remember things better when

options.text: Watching illustrations / illustrative videos that explain the concept
Drew a mindmap to find the links between the concepts
Reading / Writing / Highlighting the important point
My friend explains the concepts to me
Videos with story voice overs
Posts
Reels
Puzzles / Challenges

questions.text: At a book store, what kind of book would you reach for?

options.text: A book with lots of pictures
A novel / work related book
A book with word searches or crossword puzzles
An audiobook

questions.text: When you are not sure how to spell a word, what are you most likely to do?

options.text: Read what I have written to see if it looks right
Write it down in my mind to see if it looks right
Spell it out loud to see if it sounds right
Trace the letters in the air (finger spelling)

questions.text: When you see the word 'cat,' what do you do first?

options.text: Picture a cat in your mind
Think about being with a cat (petting it or hearing it purr)
Say the word 'cat' to yourself
Just see the word as it is

questions.text: If you were buying a new car, you would:

options.text: Discuss with your friends what kind of car you should get
Read reviews about the car online or in magazines
Look at the model / build of the car and get the one that looks the best
Test-drive lots of different types of cars before you buy

questions.text: What do you find most distracting when you are trying to study?

options.text: People walking past you
A novel / storybook
An uncomfortable chair
Loud noises

questions.text: What do you like to do to relax?

options.text: Watch a movie / a TV show
Exercise (walk, run, play sports, etc.)
Listen to music
Read

questions.text: What is the best way for you to remember something (e.g., a phone number)?

options.text: Write it down or store it in your phone
Say it out loud over and over
Picture the numbers on the phone as you would dial them
Practice dialing it

questions.text: When you need directions for travelling, you prefer to:

options.text: Ask for spoken directions
Read a map and follow it
Trust your instincts and follow your nose
Follow the sign boards

questions.text: If you were learning how to use a new piece of technology, you would:

options.text: Watch a video about it
Have a go and try to figure it out for yourself
Listen to someone explain how to use it
Read the instructions

questions.text: When I want to learn about a new project, I would ask for:

options.text: Examples where the project has been used successfully
Diagrams to show the project stages with charts, benefits, and costs
A written report describing the main features of the project
An opportunity to discuss the project

questions.text: I prefer a presenter or a teacher who uses:

options.text: Handouts, books, or readings
Question and answer, talk, group discussion, or guest speakers
Demonstrations, models or practical sessions
Diagrams, charts, maps or graphs

questions.text: When learning from the internet, I like:

options.text: Audio channels where I can listen to podcasts or interviews
Interesting written descriptions, lists, and explanations
Videos showing how to do or make things
Interesting design and visual features
